name: Collette
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a deep espresso root that melts into a soft, neutral brunette through the mid-lengths. The color gradually brightens into creamy beige blonde through the lower lengths. Pale blonde highlights start right at the hairline, framing both sides of the face and standing out against the darker crown.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
features: Bleached Knots/ HD Diamond Lace/Single knots
